Hi families,

Today’s dinner chat idea: Let's talk about how some people never give up on their beliefs, even when things get tough. Like if your favorite toy breaks but you still believe it can be fixed and play with it again someday.

One honest thing to check today: See who in the family has a piggy bank or savings jar that they always add money to, no matter what.

A simple test for the day: Ask someone at home why they save their allowance. Write down two reasons each person gives you and see if they change over time.

Wishing you all a warm dinner tonight!

Warmly,
Your Friendly Note Team
